name: Arizon RFID Technology (Cayman) Co., Ltd.
summary: Arizon RFID Technology (Cayman) Co., Ltd., along with its various subsidiaries, specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for radio-frequency identification (RFID) systems. Their operations encompass the entire lifecycle, from designing and developing these systems to manufacturing and distributing them commercially. Established in 2021, the company serves markets in Taiwan, China, and across the broader international landscape. Arizon RFID Technology maintains its corporate headquarters in Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands, and functions as a subsidiary entity of YFY Global Investment B.V.
